newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-FACTFILE ON ATLETICO MADRID'S NEW SIGNING JUNINHO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FACTFILE ON ATLETICO MADRID'S NEW SIGNING JUNINHO.

text.p: Factfile on Juninho who joined
Atletico Madrid from Middlesbrough on Tuesday for $20.2 million.
February 22, 1973 Born in Sao Paulo, Brazil. Full name Osvaldo
Giraldo Junior
Height: 1.69 metres (5ft 5 inches)
Weight: 57.2 kgs (126 pounds)
1990 - Signs for Brazilian First Division club Ituano
1993 - Joins Brazilian champions Sao Paulo for $400,000
- Plays as a substitute when Sao Paulo beat AC Milan in
World
Club Cup Final in Tokyo
1994 - Voted Brazilian Player of the Year
Feb.1995 - Scores on his international debut in Brazil's 5-0
win over Slovakia
Nov.1995 - Signs for Middlesbrough for then club-record fee of
million pounds ($7.6 million).
May 1996 - Completes first season in English League with two
goals in 21 League appearances
July 1996 - Makes five appearances and scores one goal for
Brazil Olympic team which finishes with soccer bronze medal in
Atlanta Olympic Games.
August 1996 - Returns for second season in England with
Middlesbrough who end traumatic season relegated from Premier
League and beaten in both the F.A. Cup Final and League Cup
Final.
Juninho plays in 34 of Boro's 38 league matches, scoring 12
goals and adds another three cup goals to that total.
May 1997 - Confirms desire to leave relegated Middlesbrough
saying he needs a move to a high profile Spanish team to keep
alive chances of being in Brazil squad for World Cup Finals next
year.
June 1997 - Dropped from Brazil squad for Tournoi de France.
July 1997 - Despite late intervention by Tottenham Hotspur who
agree an 11.0 million pounds ($18.6 million) deal with
Middlesbrough, Juninho, as had been widely predicted since May,
joins Atletico Madrid for $20.2 million.
